label: Judge main effect
definition: Between-judge offset after within-(judge,response) centering; expected to be exactly zero by construction.

label: Displayed-label main effect
definition: Universal pull of a displayed label across judges.

label: Judge × displayed-label interaction
definition: Judge-specific departures from the universal displayed-label pull.

label: Within-cell residual
definition: Response-level idiosyncratic label noise left after the 4×4 cell means.

label: All structured 4×4 cell means
definition: Judge main + displayed-label main + judge×label interaction.
